title: sess_reset ignores return of crypto_aead_setauthsize without WARN_ON
description: kcapi_aead.c sess_reset calls crypto_aead_setauthsize(ctx->tfm, GCM_TAG_SIZE) and discards the return value without comment. It cannot fail for 16 bytes (always valid GCM authsize), but ignoring a kernel function return with no WARN_ON is a real code review target. Fix: add (void)crypto_aead_setauthsize(...) with a comment, or WARN_ON the return.
close_reason: WARN_ON(crypto_aead_setauthsize()) in sess_reset; cannot fail for GCM_TAG_SIZE=16
